description: Frozen adversarial stems for code→canvas hill-climb (CODE-TO-CANVAS-HILLCLIMB.md §3.2 / §4 Phase M2). Structural CI only until developed scores land. toast/progress-bar refs (2026-08-08): DEVELOPED references rendered offline from their promoted contracts via the gate's own emit pipeline (emit-html + astryx token stylesheet + shipped minted tree, pinned headless Chromium, stage screenshot) — these stems were never computed-captured, so no gate-shots exist; astryx fonts stay UNCONFIGURED by name (FC-FONT-SUBSTRATE precedent), the refs render the CSS fallback stack. 2026-08-08 REFERENCE-TRUTH round: altitude/badge, tailwind/toggle-switch and carbon/checkbox retargeted from trap-corpus contract-render copies to the REAL LIBRARY RENDER under extract/computed/out/<lib>/<comp>/orig-shots/ (run.ts --keep-originals), matching the lane receipts so a --manifest rescore cannot silently restore the contract-render basis. polaris/text-field, polaris/button and astryx/toast keep non-orig-shots references by name — see each lane LEDGER. ALSO 2026-08-08: polaris/text-field and polaris/button manifest references were DIVERGENT from their lane receipts (examples/polaris/receipts/... vs parity/receipts/console-loop/polaris/refs/...), so a --manifest rescore silently rewrote those two scorecards onto a different picture (text-field 4.77 pass -> 4.80 fail, button 16.62 -> 44.37). Aligned to the receipt references; the divergence itself is recorded in the polaris LEDGER as an instrument defect.
_astryxReferenceNote: 2026-08-08 REFERENCE-TRUTH round: the four astryx rows with a computed capture now point at extract/computed/out/astryx/<comp>/orig-shots/ — the REAL @astryxdesign/core render, committed for the first time by `extract/computed/run.ts --keep-originals`. They previously pointed at trap-corpus snapshots cut from gate-shots, i.e. the CONTRACT RENDER (enriched contract -> emit-html), not the library. Both scoring paths (manifest mode and --lib/--stem, which reads receipt.visual.reference) now resolve the same PNG; before this they disagreed, so a bare `npm run console-loop:developed-score` would silently overwrite the lane scorecards with numbers measured against a different picture. astryx/toast keeps its trap snapshot: Toast is composition-tier and has no single-component capture.
